result.title: Post-Inference Model Chaining: A Problem Statement and a Model-based Bootstrap for Training End-to-End Digital Twins
result.summary: End-to-end digital twins can be constructed by fitting separate stage models and connecting them after inference. We investigate the Frequentist prediction properties of a commonly used Monte Carlo simulation scheme that forwards complete predictive draws through such a chain when measured stage outputs contain independent normal errors, but the latent stage means are deterministic. Analytical two-stage examples show persistent asymptotic interval and coverage inflation and, with quadratic propagation, mean bias dependent on the parameters to be estimated. Simulations of four- and eight-stage linear-quadratic univariate chains with 7, 15 or 30 training runs demonstrate pronounced input-dependent distortions. A diagnostic using error-free latent training predictors shows that the effect is mainly not attributable to errors in variables, but to the MCSim approach even showing underestimation of coverage. We propose a model-based bootstrap: an initial chain forwards fitted means, bootstrap chains are refitted on fixed-center bootstrap data while forwarding their mean prediction, and a target-stage future error enters a studentized prediction root. Across the investigated scenarios, relative mean bias is substantially reduced, and coverage is closer to the nominal 90%. At sample size 30, the eight-stage bootstrap has mean width ratios of 1.16-1.42 relative to the known-parameter normal reference, compared with 4.11-4.97 for observed-to-observed MCSim. These results support improved endpoint prediction in the tested setting. Further investigations of the bootstrap scheme in the supplement for a bivariate 6-stage process show similar satisfactory results.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对「逐阶段拟合、推理后串联」的端到端数字孪生，分析将完整预测抽样沿链条前传的蒙特卡洛方案在小样本多阶段情形下的区间与覆盖率畸变，并提出一种基于模型的 bootstrap，用固定中心的重采样链重拟合加学生化预测根来改善端点预测的偏差与覆盖率。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其对多阶段潜变量均值链路中误差累积、预测区间覆盖率失真以及 bootstrap 校正的分析，可能为多步 latent 推理链的置信度校准与停止决策（STOP）提供可供核查的统计视角。
